title: Yoga  A Way of Life
subject: English
summary: “Yoga – A Way of Life” is a chapter about the importance of yoga in our daily lives. Yoga is an ancient practice that helps us keep our body and mind healthy. It includes different exercises, breathing techniques and meditation. Practising yoga regularly makes us strong, flexible and peaceful. It also improves our concentration and reduces stress. Yoga is useful for people of all ages and helps us live a healthy and happy life. The chapter teaches us that we should practise yoga every day to keep our body and mind fit and healthy.
